name: projects-emergence
description: A research-driven Agent Skill that turns rough ideas into reproducible, reflective, and publishable projects for Codex and compatible coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough ideas into evidence-backed projects.
interface.longDescription: Develop a rough idea through proportionate research, evidence gates, minimal implementation, reflection, and a reviewable publication handoff.
defaultPrompt: I have a project idea. Help me research it before we build.
Turn this rough idea into a small, testable project.
Review this project and decide what evidence is still missing.
